usage: jbus flow [-h] [--since SINCE] [--until UNTIL] [--json] [--rows]
                 [--journal JOURNAL] [--no-github] [--jobs] [--no-journal]
                 {nudges,asks} ...

positional arguments:
  {nudges,asks}
    nudges           the owner's nudges in the home threads, from T3 Code's
                     store
    asks             the owner's status asks per job and per day, from T3
                     Code's store

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --since SINCE      from this time, the user's zone with none (default: 7
                     days)
  --until UNTIL      to this time, the user's zone with none, as --since
                     (default: now)
  --json             print the measure as JSON
  --rows             every merged row, each span with its record
  --journal JOURNAL  read jbus's journal lines from this file, not journalctl
  --no-github        ask GitHub nothing
  --jobs             ask each run's jobs for queue time: a call per run
  --no-journal       read no journal
